quest.title: An Opportunity for Rebirth
quest.description: You and Paimon arrive at the dormitories in the Fortress of Meropide...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x500, Mora x35475, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

chapter.title: Reborn in the Land of Grievances

talks.objective: Go to the dormitories in the Fortress of Meropide
Go to the dormitories in the Fortress of Meropide

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We once thought the Fortress of Meropide would be super scary, but looking back on it, it really wasn't that bad at all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You've got a set schedule, guaranteed food and board, and you can even buy all kinds of stuff with Credit Coupons. It's really no surprise that many people don't even want to leave.

choices.text: Yeah, you're right.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, you mean Wriothesley? He's definitely a pretty impressive leader.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: While he does look kind of intimidating, he's actually pretty easy to talk to once you've had a conversation or two with him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon wonders how he's like with the people here... Do they also get the same guy we do, or is he a lot harsher with the bad guys?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: He probably has a good number of tricks for every situation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... He must be doing something right to maintain order here, while not making everything feel super oppressive.
Excuse me, did I hear someone there? Could you please do me a favor?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Uh... Paimon could've sworn she just heard something...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Me too...
Excuse me, is someone passing by? Could you do me a favor, please?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nope, Paimon wasn't dreaming. There's someone over there for sure, but... Paimon doesn't see anyone...
Ah, did you two hear my call? Thank you so much... I'm over here, inside this big box.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Uhh... You're inside the box!? No wonder Paimon didn't see anything... Well, c'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's go take a look.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm... Why are you hiding in here, anyway? If we hadn't happened to pass by, you could have been stuck for days!

response.speaker: Faissolle
response.text: Uhh, it's a bit complicated... Can we not talk about that for now?

choices.text: Did someone... shave your eyebrows?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, that's terrible! Did someone seriously do that to you?

response.speaker: Faissolle
response.text: No, no, it was nothing quite that serious. I'd just like some help finding my hat...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just your hat? But then... Why can't you look for it yourself?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, Paimon gets it! Something must have happened to your hair...

choices.text: Paimon, we don't have to ask.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sorry, sorry! So that's what happened... Paimon gets it now. Hehe, no wonder why you had to hide inside the box!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, you just need your hat, right? We'll get it back to you right away! What kind of hat was it?

response.speaker: Faissolle
response.text: I think you may have misunderstood me, but... *sigh* Never mind, please just help me find my hat.

response.speaker: Faissolle
response.text: It's a soft and brown hat, with a bit of a brim. Nothing fancy.

response.speaker: Faissolle
response.text: I think I probably lost it near the entrance elevator. It was getting a bit hot, so I took it off and had a quick nap. But when I came to, it was gone...

response.speaker: Faissolle
response.text: It's really important to me, so your help would mean the world. I'll wait here for your return.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, we'll be back in no time!

choices.text: Paimon, there's no need to spell it out.
Did someone... strip you of your clothes?
They probably have that guy to thank for that.

talks.objective: Look for the hat near the lift
Look for the hat near the box
Look for the hat near the railings

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nothing in the water, either... Paimon thought it might have gotten blown in...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've looked everywhere, and still not seen anything that looks like a hat...

choices.text: Let's turn back. We can't scour the entire Fortress.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, that's a good idea! If he's just looking to cover his head, then it shouldn't matter what kind of hat he's wearing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why don't we check out the Rag and Bone Shop? If memory serves, they've got all kinds of stuff in there!

choices.text: You sure get fired up quick when it comes to shopping...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, you'll let Paimon pick out some other stuff too, right? If we're going to the shop anyway...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, either way, let's go check it out first.

choices.text: ...I'm only paying for the hat.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? How did you know what Paimon was thinking!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* This is bad, nothing gets past you nowadays...

choices.text: We can just buy him a hat.

talks.objective: Go to the Rag and Bone Shop

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Paimon doesn't remember you being the boss...

dialogues.speaker: Chamboduc
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I'm just standing in for Mr. Alvard while he's off restocking the shop.

dialogues.speaker: Chamboduc
dialogues.text: #Now just wait a sec... a {M#blond}{F#blonde} foreigner dressed all in white, accompanied by a glaze-covered flying chunk of gingerbread...

dialogues.speaker: Chamboduc
dialogues.text: You must be the legendary Traveler and their companion Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #No! Uh... Well, you're... half right? Paimon's {NICKNAME}'s treasured companion, sure, but she's not some flying chunk of gingerbread!

dialogues.speaker: Chamboduc
dialogues.text: Sorry, sorry! I just... I never thought I'd get the chance to see you with my own eyes, so I got a bit ahead of myself.

dialogues.speaker: Chamboduc
dialogues.text: I hope you'll find it in your magnanimous hearts to forgive my discourtesy. I'm just a nobody, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, there's no need to put yourself down like that! Paimon's just venting...

dialogues.speaker: Chamboduc
dialogues.text: Well, your heroic actions at Erinnyes have long made their way to the Fortress of Meropide.

dialogues.speaker: Chamboduc
dialogues.text: We heard that you were personally received by His Grace when you made your way down here, you know. Ah, you were the envy of all...

dialogues.speaker: Chamboduc
dialogues.text: And you're now one of His Grace's favorite people, so of course, everyone wants to be introduced to you.

choices.text: Ah, so it's because of him...

response.speaker: Chamboduc
response.text: Haha, I figured you'd appreciate honesty over flattery.

response.speaker: Chamboduc
response.text: After all, I also only joined up here because I'd heard Mr. Alvard was a good friend of the Duke.

response.speaker: Chamboduc
response.text: And though I've only caught scant sight of His Grace since then, as fate would have it, I've become fast friends with Mr. Alvard himself.

response.speaker: Chamboduc
response.text: I mean, we've all got agendas, but rather than trying to force something to be true, it's often better to just go with the flow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so now, you're trying to kiss up to us.

response.speaker: Chamboduc
response.text: Well, I did mean it when I called you legends, and it is indeed an honor to meet the two of you.

response.speaker: Chamboduc
response.text: But enough of that — is there something you're looking for?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A man's hat.

response.speaker: Chamboduc
response.text: No problem. Anything else?

response.speaker: Chamboduc
response.text: Feel free to check out anything you want. The Credit Coupon costs are on me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, but that's... You don't have to be so nice!

response.speaker: Chamboduc
response.text: Well, it's not like I'm getting paid to watch this shop. Instead of Mora or coupons, Mr. Alvard usually just lets me take my pick of our goods.

response.speaker: Chamboduc
response.text: Life's been pretty good recently, so I might as well just waive your bill. Never hurts to make some friends...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, if you put it that way...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright... Paimon will take a look...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After a moment's hesitation, Paimon manages to pick out two snacks.

response.speaker: Chamboduc
response.text: Are you sure you don't want more? These opportunities don't come by every day, you know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's alright! Two will do.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I never thought you'd turn down a chance to freeload...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh, it just doesn't feel the same if the owner's offering everything to you for free!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But anyway, we don't need to get into that right now. We can discuss Paimonology later — that poor guy must still be waiting for us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thank you so much! We'll be off, then.

response.speaker: Chamboduc
response.text: No problem, and thank you for your patronage! I'd appreciate it if you could put in a nice word for our establishment the next time you speak to His Grace.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's a real sneaky way of getting good reviews...

choices.text: And here I thought I had made it as a hero...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You can come out now! We've found your hat.

dialogues.speaker: Faissolle
dialogues.text: You did? Oh, Archons, you've just saved my life! Just one sec...

dialogues.speaker: Faissolle
dialogues.text: Hmm... Uhh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so you're not actually bald? You've got such a full head of hair, too!

dialogues.speaker: Faissolle
dialogues.text: *sigh* I mean, I told you that there had been a misunderstanding... This has nothing to do with my hair.

dialogues.speaker: Faissolle
dialogues.text: Wait, this isn't my hat...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we got you a new one! We tried really hard to look for your hat, but no dice.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: To be precise, someone else gave it to us...

dialogues.speaker: Faissolle
dialogues.text: Ah, I see... Thank you so much. I'm really grateful, but unfortunately, there's just something special about my hat...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Does it have some kind of sentimental value?

dialogues.speaker: Faissolle
dialogues.text: Well, um...

dialogues.speaker: Faissolle
dialogues.text: Sorry, I can't... explain at the moment. Time's tight as well, so I suppose I'll keep looking for a while...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: If you're looking for a hat, I just picked one up over here. Is it yours?

dialogues.speaker: Faissolle
dialogues.text: Your Grace!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, hey, Wriothesley! It's been a while.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: It's a slow day today, so I decided to go for a little stroll. Even if your work space isn't cramped, it's still good to get some air.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I'll say, I'm not at all surprised to find the two of you here. You never could turn down someone's request for help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, it's what good adventurers do, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Is that so... Maybe I should consider asking the Adventurers' Guild to open a branch here.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: As I recall, these hats are very important to members of the Beret Society. Best you avoid misplacing it again, hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: You might not have the same luck next time.

dialogues.speaker: Faissolle
dialogues.text: Understood. Th—Thank you so much, Your Grace.

dialogues.speaker: Faissolle
dialogues.text: Then... Then I'll be off. Umm... I—I'll get going now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a strange guy... Why'd he care so much about his hat?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, and has he done something wrong? When he saw you, it was as if he'd seen a ghost.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Oh, not at all. In fact, members of the Beret Society are model prisoners. They work hard and never get into trouble — they've saved me a lot of work, in fact.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: As for him... I'd guess he's just more of an introvert. It's not unusual for the more shy prisoners to freak out when I show up unannounced.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Shy? There are prisoners who are... afraid to talk to people?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Prisoners are still people, after all. There are as many crimes and motives as there are stars in the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: The idea of the criminal as a selfish, heartless brute is just a stereotype. Such labels could never capture the complexity of even a single individual person.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: What kind of a person a prisoner may be, and why they have committed a crime — we'd never know these things if they don't share their story with us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, you've got a point... Anyway, it's all good as long as it makes sense to you.

choices.text: What's this "Beret Society"?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Although most of the societies here will just turn individual brawls into mass ones...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: The Beret Society does appear to be an exception in that it's instead trying to experiment with some novel and interesting things.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: If you have some time, why don't we grab something at the Coupon Cafeteria? It'll give us some time to catch up, too.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: And if you're still interested in the Berets after that, I can take you to their usual gathering place as well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's not the biggest fan of that cafeteria, but if we're gonna catch up...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's go, then.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Alright then, please follow me.

choices.text: There are people here who enjoy working?

talks.objective: Go to the Coupon Cafeteria with Wriothesley

dialogues.speaker: Wolsey
dialogues.text: Welcome, Your Grace, and the Traveler. Would you like three orders of today's Welfare Meal?

dialogues.speaker: Wolsey
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, we weren't informed of your visit in advance, so we didn't prepare any Super Deluxe Welfare Meals today...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I'll pass on the food, then. What about you?

choices.text: I'm not hungry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Then, Paimon will also pass. Paimon will save her stomach for something better!

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: What a pity... It would seem that none of us can properly appreciate your skills, Wolsey.

response.speaker: Wolsey
response.text: Haha, then I must beg Your Grace to find me some more ingredients, so I can come up with some more Welfare Meal recipes.

response.speaker: Wolsey
response.text: If you're not in the mood to eat, I can get you some drinks. We just got some great shipments in from above.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes please! Huh, Paimon didn't know you could get non-Welfare stuff at this place.

response.speaker: Wolsey
response.text: Haha, it's not for everyone. Think of it as a special treat for VIPs.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, now that's what Paimon likes to hear! In that case, two bottles of the drink for Paimon, please!

response.speaker: Wolsey
response.text: Two bottles, coming right up!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After a while, Wolsey brings out the drinks for everyone.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Our first meeting took place on short notice, and we were both swamped by everything that happened after, so there was no time for more casual chit-chat.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I'm actually quite fond of stories, you know. Of course, the others have already told me a lot about your deeds in Fontaine, but I'd love to hear it straight from the source.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, that'd be quite the long story...

choices.text: We fought tooth and nail for the sake of justice.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Impressive. Not all who possess the courage to risk their life for their ideals also have the strength to make it out unscathed.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Had you not possessed these remarkable qualities, I probably wouldn't have had the chance to make your acquaintance in the first place.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon gets the sense that you're trying to flatter us...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That guy we talked to earlier was obviously trying to get us to put in a good word for him, but you're the Duke, right? Why would you need to get on our good side?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Well, after all, you did help the Fortress and I maintain our autonomy.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Is it so strange that I would want to give a few words of praise out of genuine admiration?

choices.text: Just a little bit.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Ah, so this is a matter of trust. Which is unfortunate, since I don't have nearly as interesting of a story to offer about myself.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I was convicted and sent here at an early age. I only became the top dog after spending a long time figuring out its inner workings.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Power and control come in many forms, some fair and ethical, others less so. And since we're all sinners here, the victor calls the shots, no matter how they managed to get to the top.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: So, what do you think? Didn't put you much more at ease, now did it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, kinda... You're really different from most of the people we've met so far...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Haha, I'm perfectly aware of that, too. But even so, that doesn't make me think any less of you.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I would very much like to maintain friendly relations with you two.

choices.text: That's how I feel as well.

response.speaker: Guelet
response.text: Your Grace, after following your instructions, we were able to find a box of undeclared contraband in the latest shipment of cargo.

response.speaker: Guelet
response.text: They were extremely well-hidden, and we've confirmed that the senders have been using this method to smuggle goods for a while. We're trying to trace the goods to their source.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Got it. Leave the box here, and contact me immediately if you make any progress. You're dismissed.

response.speaker: Guelet
response.text: Yes, Your Grace.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Sorry, I'd almost completely forgotten about this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She mentioned something about "contraband." Are they like, dangerous goods?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Not necessarily. The term is just applied to things people want to bring in on the sly.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Many people here are experts at pulling rabbits out of the most ordinary hats, so we have to examine everything carefully.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Now, what do we have here... Hmm, it's more or less what I expected.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, this is certainly a box of curiosities! Mora, snacks, yarn balls, ropes, mechanical parts, and even a gem!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, if you've confiscated this entire box, then does that mean... all of this belongs to you now?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Yep. We can't just send them back up now, can we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Whaaaat? But that's just insane profit! {NICKNAME}, why don't you become a Duke as well?

choices.text: And what about you, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon will be your vault-keeper!

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Jokes aside, I didn't know you would be so interested in this box. How about this, then? You can pick anything you want from it. Consider it a gift from me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? You'll let Paimon pick anything?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No takebacks! Paimon will have you know that she's got a real good eye for treasure!

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I never joke about things like this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright... Paimon's gonna have a look...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon wants... this one! This dark, sparkly gem — you just know it must be worth a ton of Mora!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm... Uhh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Actually, never mind. Paimon doesn't want this gem anymore... Can Paimon pick something else instead?

choices.text: Paimon, what's wrong?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's something... weird about this gem. Paimon remembered a lot of bad things when she picked it up...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon couldn't even tune them out... It's as if the gem was just drawing them out of Paimon's brain. It was super spooky...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Is that so? Let me give it a try.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Uhh...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Paimon's right. I, too, experienced some unpleasant flashbacks.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Huh, let me try...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Are you sure? I wouldn't exactly call it fun.

choices.text: I want to make sure I know exactly what you saw.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Fair enough. Go ahead. I don't think it'll have a permanent effect.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Are you okay, {NICKNAME}? You also saw something, right?

choices.text: Yeah, it's just as you said.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I'll take this gem, then, and run a thorough investigation on its properties. Paimon, feel free to pick something else.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then... Actually, never mind. Paimon's gonna pass. Paimon was thinking about one of the snacks, but who knows if it'll also make Paimon sick...

choices.text: An astute decision.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: You do have a point. In that case, we should destroy the entire box and all of its contents.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Seems like we're almost done with our drinks, too. Let's go check out the Society's gathering place, then.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I can introduce you, and we can also continue our conversation while we're at it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, are you this free every day or something?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Just noticed? I wasn't exactly busy the first time we met, either.

choices.text: It doesn't hurt to be careful.
I relived some... rather unforgettable memories.
My constitution is a bit different from everyone else's.
Are you feeling unwell?
Let's get that title, then.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: It's only been a couple minutes since we agreed to continue friendly relations with each other, and you're already planning to overthrow me?

choices.text: I must thank you for your generosity, but...
It's because you don't ever talk about yourself.
I'm still trying to learn more about Fontaine.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I see. Certainly, that'd fit your title as the Traveler.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Seeing everything for yourself, recording everything to the best of your ability, and making lots of friends along the way... I'm sure that by the end of your journey, you'll possess an unmatched amount of perspectives and opportunities.

choices.text: To be honest, I really wasn't that involved with a lot of it...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Haha, that's a bit too humble for you.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Even the most unintentional action can catalyze new developments, and force many fates onto brand new paths.

choices.text: Super Deluxe or bust.

dialogues.speaker: Faissolle
dialogues.text: I'm really sorry to bother you like this... Please come back soon!

dialogues.speaker: Chamboduc
dialogues.text: Please come again! And don't forget to mention us to Your Grace!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just where is that thing? This is taking longer than Paimon thought...
